font-family: courier;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: large;\"\u003EI\u0026nbsp;am\u0026nbsp;Saranya ,currently an intern posted in the department of General Medicine\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #38761d; font-family: courier; font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003EGreetings to all my readers;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #38761d; font-family: courier; font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003EThis is an elog documenting the patients that I witness during my Rotatory Internship Postings to enforce a greater patient centered learning\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #38761d; font-family: courier; font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #38761d; font-family: courier; font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003Cspan\u003E\u003Cu\u003EDEIDENTIFICATION\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u0026nbsp;:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #38761d; font-family: courier; font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003EThe\u0026nbsp;privacy\u0026nbsp;of the patient is being entirely conserved. No identifiers shall be revealed\u0026nbsp;through out the piece of work whatsoever.\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #38761d; font-family: courier; font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #38761d; font-family: courier; font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cspan\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan\u003E\u003Cu\u003E\u003Cspan\u003ECONSENT\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/u\u003E\u0026nbsp;:\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #38761d; font-family: courier; font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u0026nbsp;An informed consent has been taken from the patient in the presence of the family attenders and other witnesses as well and the document has been conserved securely for future references.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #38761d; font-family: courier; font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #38761d; font-family: courier; font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003E\u003Cspan\u003EACKNOWLEDGMENT\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/u\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #38761d; font-family: courier; font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003EI convey my regards to\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;Dr. Lohith\u0026nbsp; and Dr.Narsimha Reddy ( Resident , Department of General Medicine )\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;for guiding me regarding the case .\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #38761d; font-family: courier; font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #38761d; font-family: courier; font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003E\u003Cspan\u003EINTRODUCTION\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/u\u003E\u0026nbsp;:\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #38761d; font-family: courier; font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003EMy patient\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;is a 70 year old man, a labourer in young days,now retired, resident of a rural district of South India\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #38761d; font-family: courier; font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #38761d; font-family: courier; font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003E\u003Cspan\u003ECHIEF COMPLAINTS\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/u\u003E:\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #38761d; font-family: courier; font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003EOur patient came with complaints of wound on Right foot since 2 years , fever since 1 day.\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #38761d;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cp style=\"font-family: courier;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"font-family: courier;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"font-family: courier;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: large;\"\u003EHISTORY OF PRESENTING ILLNESS:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"font-family: courier;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: large;\"\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 2 years back when he gives history of trauma to right foot resulting in trauma ( thorn pricking on the sole of the right foot ) , that wound was not healing, since then there is ulcer on his right sole.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"font-family: courier;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: large;\"\u003EPatient has pain in his right foot, A\/w pins and needles; tingling and numbness in both upper and lower limb.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"font-family: courier;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: large;\"\u003EPatient is having fever since 1 day.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"font-family: courier;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: large;\"\u003EHigh grade fever, intermittent , resolving with antipyretic medication\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"font-family: courier;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"font-family: courier;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: large;\"\u003EOTHER CO MORBIDITIES :\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"font-family: courier;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"font-family: courier;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: large;\"\u003EHe is a k\/c\/o DM 2 , HTN since 2 years on oral medications.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"font-family: courier;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: large;\"\u003ENo c\/o SOB, Chest pain ,Palpitation orthopnea , PND , pedal edema\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"font-family: courier;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: large;\"\u003EC\/o frequency , urgency , dribbling of urine\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"font-family: courier;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: Rock Salt; font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cspan\u003EBiopsychosocial history\u003C\/span\u003E :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"font-family: courier;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: Homemade Apple; font-size: large;\"\u003EPatient is too old to go to work, previously he used to be a labourer but has stopped going to work, his wife has passed away, children have left the house ,settled in other parts of the city and they do not maintain contact with their father, he lives all alone in his rural house, no care taker, money and daily basic household needs are also a constraint for him. He came to the hospital by himself because he was troubled by his wound and fever had also added up.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: Homemade Apple; font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: Rock Salt; font-size: large;\"\u003EHis Daily Routine :\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: Homemade Apple; font-size: large;\"\u003EHis day begins early in the morning\u0026nbsp; when he needs to wake up even when he does not feel like, because he knows that he has to get going ,to fill vessels of water for the day, for drinking and household chores ,and after\u0026nbsp; a certain time , the source water stops, hence that is the way the day begins ,\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: Homemade Apple; font-size: large;\"\u003EEven though the foot is painful, and he is weak with the burden of age and life events ,he has no other option but to pull himself up and head towards making some food for himself , he has somehow managed to buy a small cooking gas cylinder in which he cooks his 2 square meals of the day, which mostly comprises of rice and a curry\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: Homemade Apple;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: large;\"\u003EWe wouldn't mind to eat a better variety and maybe a more healthier plate \u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: large;\"\u003Ebut his resources and energy to make the meals by himself is too constrained to even think of those options\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: Homemade Apple; font-size: large;\"\u003EThis he does just for survival ,and because when in hunger he needs to eat atleast something , he also mentions a sentence saying( in his own language ; that I shall translate in English for the readers understanding\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: Homemade Apple; font-size: large;\"\u003E\" My hunger has died , no don't think I don't feel hungry, I do ,but when I think ,again It is me who has to arrange everything\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: Rock Salt; font-size: large;\"\u003E , \u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: Homemade Apple; font-size: large;\"\u003Ea part of the\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: Rock Salt; font-size: large;\"\u003E hunger \u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: Homemade Apple; font-size: large;\"\u003Evanishes ,and rest of it vanishes when I think that everyone in my life left me alone and left \".\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: Homemade Apple; font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: Homemade Apple; font-size: large;\"\u003EAfter his meal preparation,\u0026nbsp; he eats his food , takes some rest , and then again gets started in washing the used utensils , and once in couple of days cleaning\u0026nbsp; the room.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: Homemade Apple; font-size: large;\"\u003EThrough the day, In between the works he tries to rest at times ,\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: Homemade Apple; font-size: large;\"\u003EIn the late afternoons , some days he goes out to buy small necessary things ,going and coming back,takes a lot of time,since he walks slowly with the assistance of a stick.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: Homemade Apple; font-size: large;\"\u003EHe finishes his dinner,\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: Homemade Apple; font-size: large;\"\u003EAnd goes to bed.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr patient\u0026nbsp; was born in a common Indian household in the 1960s .Sh\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: \u0026quot;Homemade Apple\u0026quot;;\"\u003Ee was the second eldest among the four siblings.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: \u0026quot;Homemade Apple\u0026quot;;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: \u0026quot;Homemade Apple\u0026quot;;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003EShe was raised in a rural background ,in a family where the parents were engaged in daily wage work ,earning square meals for their children ,but\u0026nbsp;
